title: Keto French Terrine with Mushroom
description: A rich and creamy keto terrine filled with sautéed mushrooms, perfect for a low-carb meal.
instructions: In a skillet, sauté the mushrooms in French butter until tender.
In a separate skillet, cook the cured pork belly until crispy.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and heavy cream.
Add the grated cheese and mix until well combined.
Add the cooked mushrooms and crispy pork belly to the bowl and mix well.
Pour the mixture into a terrine mold or a small baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the terrine is set and slightly golden brown.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight before serving.
